title: Byzantine Churches in Constantinople
author: Alexander Van Millingen and contributors
detail: Primary measured survey records material bands, external window types, three dormer windows per semidome, eight central drum windows and wing roof profiles. The scaled plan locates the tower and bays.
Istanbul Governorship identifies the standing mosque in Fatih and records the current five-domed portico supported by six columns, central dome, paired semidomes, and octagonal minaret base.

Semavi Eyice documents the stone outer envelope, the eastern sanctuary roof visible above it, the paired three-window semidomes, and the tower’s stepped base, ornament, faceted shaft and single projecting balcony.
